import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD_A = 998244353;
    static final int MOD_B = 1000000007;
    static long input_number;
    static int[] digits = new int[15];
    static int[] base_vals = new int[15];
    static int final_answer = 0;
    static int[] diff_vals = new int[15];
    static int[] q1_list = new int[1000010];
    static int[] q2_list = new int[1000010];
    static long[] q2_sum = new long[1000010];

    static long extract_number(int[] arr, int len) {
        long res = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++)
            res = res * 10 + arr[i];
        return res;
    }

    static long get_rank(int[] arr, int len) {
        long total = 0;
        for (int d = 1; d <= digits[0]; d++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= Math.min(len, d); i++) {
                for (int j = (i == 1 ? 1 : 0); j < arr[i]; j++) {
                    long leftPart = 0, rightPart = 0;
                    for (int p = 1; p < i; p++)
                        leftPart = rightPart = leftPart * 10 + arr[p];
                    leftPart = rightPart = leftPart * 10 + j;
                    for (int p = i + 1; p <= d; p++)
                        leftPart = leftPart * 10;
                    rightPart = rightPart * 10 + 9;
                    rightPart = Math.min(rightPart, input_number);
                    if (leftPart <= rightPart)
                        total += rightPart - leftPart + 1;
                }
            }
            if (d <= len)
                total++;
        }
        return total;
    }

    static int computeF(int[] arr, int len) {
        long res = ((-extract_number(arr, len) + get_rank(arr, len)) % MOD_A + MOD_A) % MOD_A;
        return (int) res;
    }

    static void dfs_range(int start, int end, int[] q, int v) {
        if (start == end) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++)
                q[++q[0]] = (int) ((v + 1L * i * diff_vals[start]) % MOD_A);
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++)
            dfs_range(start + 1, end, q, (int) ((v + 1L * i * diff_vals[start]) % MOD_A));
    }

    static void do_update(int len, int idx, int val) {
        int[] backup = new int[15];
        System.arraycopy(digits, 0, backup, 0, 15);
        digits[idx] = val;
        for (int p = idx + 1; p <= len; p++)
            digits[p] = 0;
        int baseVal = computeF(digits, len);
        for (int p = idx + 1; p <= len; p++) {
            digits[p] = 1;
            diff_vals[p] = (int) ((computeF(digits, len) + MOD_A - baseVal) % MOD_A);
            digits[p] = 0;
        }
        if (len - idx == 0) {
            final_answer = (final_answer + baseVal) % MOD_B;
            return;
        }
        if (len - idx == 1) {
            for (int p = 0; p <= 9; p++)
                final_answer = (int) ((final_answer + (baseVal + 1L * p * diff_vals[len]) % MOD_A) % MOD_B);
            return;
        }
        int mid = (len + idx) / 2;
        q1_list[0] = 0;
        q2_list[0] = 0;
        dfs_range(idx + 1, mid, q1_list, baseVal);
        dfs_range(mid + 1, len, q2_list, 0);
        Arrays.sort(q2_list, 1, q2_list[0] + 1);
        long sumQ2 = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= q2_list[0]; i++)
            sumQ2 = (sumQ2 + q2_list[i]) % MOD_B;
        for (int i = 1; i <= q1_list[0]; i++) {
            int p = lowerBound(q2_list, 1, q2_list[0], MOD_A - q1_list[i]);
            final_answer = (int) ((final_answer + sumQ2 + 1L * q2_list[p] * q1_list[i]) % MOD_B);
            final_answer = (int) ((final_answer + 1L * (q2_list[0] - p + 1) * (MOD_B - MOD_A)) % MOD_B);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(int[] arr, int start, int end, int target) {
        int low = start, high = end;
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (arr[mid] >= target)
                high = mid;
            else
                low = mid + 1;
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        input_number = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        long m = input_number;
        int len = 0;
        while (m > 0) {
            digits[++len] = (int) (m % 10);
            m /= 10;
        }
        digits[1..len] = reverse(Arrays.copyOfRange(digits, 1, len + 1));
        digits[0] = len;
        for (int d = 1; d <= digits[0]; d++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= d; i++) {
                int l = (i == 1 ? 1 : 0);
                int r = (d == digits[0] ? digits[i] - 1 : 9);
                for (int j = l; j <= r; j++) {
                    if (j != digits[i]) do_update(d, i, j);
                }
            }
            final_answer = (final_answer + computeF(digits, d)) % MOD_B;
        }
        System.out.println(final_answer);
    }

    static int[] reverse(int[] arr) {
        int[] res = new int[arr.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)
            res[i] = arr[arr.length - 1 - i];
        return res;
    }
}
